messages:
maya (cust-success): FYI, Forsage (customer) dropped a request to run their Forsage-7B model in private with low-latency SLOs. They attached a .pt export and want quantized variants. Asking for timeline and blockers.

dario (eng-ml): Got it. Can we get a short spec from them: target p95 latency, QPS, max token length, and whether they need streaming?

maya (cust-success): They answered in thread: target p95 ~120ms (single-token streaming), sustained QPS 40, peak burst 120, max seq 1024, must support streaming. Data plane in us-west2 VPC.

dario (eng-ml): Thanks. Initial triage: this is medium-high priority due to SLA ask + private deployment. Main workstreams: 1) model conversion + sanity run, 2) quantization experiments (4/8-bit), 3) quality/regression evals vs FP16 baseline, 4) infra sizing + Dedicated slot plan, 5) rollout policy (canary + fallback).

dario (eng-ml): Quick checklist proposal: 
- get model artifacts + model card (owner: maya) 
- run smoke FP16 inference (owner: dario) 
- produce float baseline eval on internal eval set (owner: dario) 
- run 8-bit and 4-bit quant configs (owner: alyssa) 
- assemble regression suite + SLO tests (owner: eval-bot) 
- perf runs on us-west2 (owner: ryan)

alyssa (mlinfra): I'll start with quant configs. Proposed experiments: 
```
configs = [
  {"method": "q8_0", "params": "symmetric, per-channel"},
  {"method": "q4_k_m", "params": "group 128, outlier clipping"}
]
```
I'll test EMQ and static-kv approaches. Need to know if they can accept tiny quality delta (<=1% bleu/accuracy) or stricter.

dario (eng-ml): Customer said quality: "no >2% degradation on our intent F1 and core generations". Add that to acceptance criteria.

ryan (ops): For sustained QPS 40 and p95 120ms streaming, we'll need Dedicated pools with ~4x batching headroom. My rough estimate: 4x A100-80GB or equivalent with optimized kernels. I need to run perf matrix after quant.

onboard-bot: New intake ticket created: #INTAKE-1347. Links: https://tickets.redwood/INTAKE-1347. Assigned to dario.

dario (eng-ml): Blockers we should call out now: vendor-signed model license? access to full validation set for regression, and network egress constraints for private deployment (need us-west2 peering).

maya (cust-success): Forsage confirmed license OK and will provide their eval set (anonymized) by EOD Wednesday. They also confirmed VPC peering request submitted.

dario (eng-ml): Plan & timeline (tentative): 
- Day 0: pull artifacts, FP16 smoke 
- Day 1-2: baseline eval + perf baseline 
- Day 3-5: quant runs (q8,q4) + quality evals 
- Day 6-7: performance tuning on Dedicated + canary deploy 
I'll update ticket with concrete perf numbers.

alyssa (mlinfra): One more ask: please provide a few representative prompts for long-tail behavior (they mentioned code generation and system prompt lengths). Those help tune kv cache and batching.

dario (eng-ml): @maya can you push those prompts and the anonymized eval set into the ticket when available?

maya (cust-success): will do. Also looping in @ryan on network permissions.

eval-bot: Regression job scheduled: r-job-789. Will run FP16 vs q8 vs q4 on provided eval set. Results will be posted to ticket.

dario (eng-ml): Ok assigning owners in ticket: dario (overall), alyssa (quant experiments), ryan (perf infra), maya (customer comms). If no objections I'll start FP16 smoke in ~2h. :thumbsup:

maya (cust-success): :thumbsup: thanks team.

dario (eng-ml): Starting smoke run now. Will ping with logs.

ryan (ops): I'll schedule a capacity estimate run for tomorrow morning.

maya (cust-success): Quick Q: any recommended initial batch_size / max_tokens for streaming?

dario (eng-ml): Start with batch_size=1 for p95-sensitive streaming, max_new_tokens=256, and enable prefix KV cache. We'll iterate after perf numbers.

maya (cust-success): got it, thanks.
